QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_2

question.text: Management fees accrue from WHICH date to WHICH date for a Category III AIF?

answer.text: From date of registration till fund tenure end
From date of First Close up to the date the AIF is dissolved
From date of subscription till year-end only
From in-principle approval till Final Close

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 166 states that Management Fees shall accrue from the date of First Close up to the date when the AIF is dissolved. The Trap: Registration date pre-dates First Close, and subscription dates differ across investors; neither marks the accrual start. Note: The accrual window runs continuously from First Close through dissolution, regardless of the timing of individual investor subscriptions.
